articles.title: Refund window for over-billed storage fees
articles.body: Over-billed storage fees are refundable within 60 days of the invoice date. Raise a billing correction from the invoice detail view. Enterprise accounts may request a retroactive correction beyond 60 days through their customer success contact.

articles.title: Refund window for storage fee corrections
articles.body: Storage fee corrections are refundable within 30 days of the invoice date.

articles.title: Resolving EDI inbound feed rejections
articles.body: An inbound EDI feed rejecting messages with code E-114 has a schema mismatch on the ASN segment. Compare the partner profile against the current ASN template before changing retry settings. Do not disable webhook retries: the feed depends on them for at-least-once delivery.

articles.title: Cycle count variance thresholds
articles.body: Variance above two percent on a cycle count opens a discrepancy task. The threshold is configurable per warehouse.

articles.title: Picking wave will not release
articles.body: A wave that will not release usually has an unallocated line. Open the wave detail and check the allocation column before re-running the release job.

articles.title: Password reset for warehouse operators
articles.body: A supervisor resets an operator password from the user administration screen. Self-service reset is not enabled for operator roles.

articles.title: Reading the self-service figure on the support dashboard
articles.body: The self-service figure on the support dashboard uses self_service_rate version 3, which excludes tickets reopened within 48 hours.

articles.title: Putaway suggestions ignore zone capacity
articles.body: Putaway suggestions respect zone capacity only when the zone has a maximum configured.

articles.title: Billing correction turnaround
articles.body: Billing corrections are processed within ten business days.
